description: Na₆U(Mo₂O₉)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.96 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.95 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.92 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.93 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with four MoO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.76 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.90 Å. U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with five MoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-61°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.45 Å. There are four inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.86 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.83 Å. In the third Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.85 Å. In the fourth Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-51°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.84 Å. There are eighteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one Mo atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one Mo atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one U atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one U, and one Mo atom.
